title: Start descending from the initial view
description: Verifies that a new user can load the app and begin a smooth descent with depth and motion responding to scroll input.

steps.description: Verify the scene shows the user descending
Verify depth and motion feedback are updating

title: Mute and restore audio without reloading
description: Verifies that audio can be muted and re-enabled from the UI while the descent view stays intact.

title: Enable and stop Zen Float
description: Verifies that the auto-descent toggle starts steady floating motion and can be stopped without losing control of the scene.

steps.description: Verify the scene continues descending automatically

title: Continue descending with repeated wheel input
description: Verifies that repeated scroll input keeps the descent responsive while motion remains smooth and bounded.

steps.description: Verify the descent continues without losing responsiveness

title: Use the fixed dock to open and dismiss a popover without clipping
description: This verifies that dock actions open root-level popovers and that tapping outside closes them cleanly without clipping the panel.

steps.description: Click the Sound control in the fixed dock
Verify the sound popover is visible
Click the backdrop outside the popover
Verify the sound popover is not visible

title: Return to the surface from depth
description: Verifies that the surface control brings the user back toward the top with smooth glide physics.

steps.description: Verify the scene glides back toward the surface
Verify the surface state is reached

title: Use touch drag to descend
description: Verifies that a touch user can drive the descent with drag gestures and see the depth state update normally.

steps.description: Verify the scene descends in response to touch input
Verify depth feedback updates during the drag

title: Discover a landmark while descending
description: This verifies that descending past a milestone reveals a discovery and saves it to the atlas for later review.

steps.description: Scroll downward until a landmark is reached
Verify a landmark discovery is displayed
Verify the discovery is saved for later access

title: Open the atlas and review saved discoveries
description: This verifies that the atlas modal opens from the current session and shows previously discovered landmarks.

steps.description: Scroll downward until a landmark is reached
Verify the atlas modal is visible

title: Open the sound controls and choose a preset
description: Verifies that a user can open the sound menu and select a procedural sound preset that becomes active immediately.

steps.description: Verify the selected sound preset is active
Verify the audio state remains stable while browsing

title: Open the breath pacer and follow the breathing rhythm
description: This verifies that the user can open the breathing guide and see the paced inhale-exhale cycle continue during descent.

steps.description: Verify the breath pacer overlay is visible
Verify the breathing animation is displayed

title: Mute the audio from the dock and keep the mute state stable
description: This verifies that the sound controls allow the user to mute procedural audio and keep that state while continuing to interact with the app.

steps.description: Click the Sound control in the fixed dock
Verify the dock controls remain accessible

title: Switch between the available themes
description: Verifies that a user can change the app palette and immediately see the interface recolor.

steps.description: Verify the new palette remains active during continued browsing

title: Pause the breath pacer and return to the default view
description: This verifies that the user can stop the breathing guide and return to the normal HUD without leaving the overlay active.

steps.description: Verify the breath pacer overlay is not visible
Verify the default HUD is visible

title: Jump to an unlocked depth from the atlas
description: This verifies that a discovered landmark in the atlas can be selected to move the user to that saved depth.

steps.description: Scroll downward until a landmark is reached
Verify the user jumps to the selected depth
Verify the atlas remains consistent after the jump

title: Switch theme from the dock and keep the selection active during descent
description: This verifies that the user can change the visual theme from the dock and continue descending with the new selection applied.

steps.description: Click the Theme control in the fixed dock
Verify the new theme is applied

title: Show an empty atlas on first use
description: This verifies that opening the atlas before any discoveries presents an empty-state experience instead of saved landmarks.

steps.description: Verify the atlas modal is visible
Verify an empty state message is visible

title: Continue descending while the breath pacer remains active
description: This verifies that opening the breathing guide does not interrupt the current descent state and the user can keep scrolling while it stays open.

steps.description: Verify the breath pacer overlay remains visible

title: Open dock popovers and keep them accessible while the scene remains visible
description: This verifies that dock popovers render above the scene and remain usable instead of being clipped behind the main canvas.

steps.description: Click the Theme control in the fixed dock
Verify the theme popover is visible
Verify the main scene remains visible behind the popover

title: Dismiss the theme popover by tapping outside it
description: Verifies that the theme menu can be closed through its backdrop without changing the current palette.

steps.description: Tap outside the open theme popover
Verify the active theme does not change

title: Keep the breath pacer stable during rapid toggling
description: This verifies that repeated quick toggles do not break the breathing guide or cause inconsistent visual state.

steps.description: Verify the breathing animation is not glitching
Verify the default HUD state remains consistent

title: Clamp aggressive input to stable motion
description: Verifies that very aggressive input is handled cleanly and the descent remains stable without overscroll behavior.

steps.description: Perform a very large downward scroll input
Verify the descent remains responsive and bounded
Verify no overscroll or visual glitch appears

title: Keep locked atlas entries unavailable before discovery
description: This verifies that undiscovered depths cannot be selected and the user stays at the current depth until they are earned.

steps.description: Select a locked landmark entry if shown
Verify locked entries cannot be opened
Verify the current depth remains unchanged

title: Ignore an unsupported sound preset
description: Verifies that choosing an invalid sound option leaves the current audio state unchanged and the interface remains stable.

steps.description: Attempt to select an unsupported sound preset
Verify the current sound preset remains active
Verify the sound controls stay usable

title: Ignore an unsupported theme choice
description: Verifies that invalid theme input is ignored cleanly and the previous palette stays active.

steps.description: Attempt to select an unsupported theme
Verify the active theme remains unchanged
Verify the interface continues rendering normally
